title: Proclamation No. 1178, s. 2026
text:
MALACANAN PALACE
MANILA

BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES

PROCLAMATION NO. 1178

DECLARING THURSDAY, 19 MARCH 2026, A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN
THE CITY OF CANLAON, PROVINCE OF NEGROS ORIENTAL

WHEREAS, on 19 March 2026, Thursday, the City of Canlaon, Province of
Negros Oriental will mark the celebration of the Pasayaw Festival 2026;

WHEREAS, it is but fitting and proper that the people of the City of Canlaon be
given full opportunity to participate in the occasion and enjoy the celebration;

NOW, THEREFORE, |, RALPH G. RECTO, Acting Executive Secretary, by
authority of the President, FERDINAND R. MARCOS, JR., do hereby declare
Thursday, 19 March 2026, a special (non-working) day in the City of Canlaon, Province
of Negros Oriental.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, | have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of
the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 20thday offebruary , in the year of Our Lord,
Two Thousand and Twenty Six.

By authority of the President:

  
 

Acting Executive’ Secretary
